name: Randomised
identifying_assumption: Random allocation gives exchangeability: treated and untreated groups differ only by chance, in measured and unmeasured characteristics alike.
designs: rct_individual rct_cluster rct_stepped_wedge rct_crossover rct_waitlist encouragement

name: Local as-if random
identifying_assumption: An assignment rule or instrument isolates exogenous variation — but only where its own conditions hold, and those conditions are themselves testable claims.

name: Comparison-group panel
identifying_assumption: Parallel trends — the treated and comparison groups would have moved together absent the intervention — or weighted comparison units that tracked the treated unit before it.

name: Selection on observables
identifying_assumption: No unmeasured confounding given the measured covariates. Untestable in principle; the argument rests on substantive knowledge of the assignment process.
maryland_note: Level 3 where pre-period outcomes are used as controls and comparability is demonstrated rather than asserted.

name: Single time series
identifying_assumption: The pre-intervention trend would have continued unchanged. No comparison group exists to falsify this, so it stands or falls on the plausibility of the counterfactual trend.
